281449996.description:
Vintage Textile Mill Bobbins
Wood Bobbin & Paper Pirn Tubes
5 Items, Mid-20th Century
This lot of five vintage textile mill bobbins includes one turned hardwood bobbin and four composite paper pirn tubes with protective metal ferrules. Originating from commercial textile manufacturing, these pieces retain authentic maker stamps and working patina, bundled with a decorative plaid fabric wrap.
ITEMS INCLUDED:
1.
Hardwood Bobbin
- Turned wood with slotted base and metal ring
2.
American Paper Tube Co. Quill
- Stamped maker mark, "MADE IN U.S.A.", dated 1947
3.
Textube Green Tube
- Stamped markings with green grid pattern and metal ferrule
4.
Textube Striped Tube
- Striped paper pirn with metal ferrule
5.
Textube 286 Tube
- Stamped "TEXTUBE 286" with metal end ferrule
Condition:
Vintage industrial condition with expected signs of mill use. Turned wood bobbin shows surface patina and minor handling marks. Paper composite tubes exhibit light edge wear, surface darkening, and natural metal oxidation on ferrules. All pieces are structurally intact.

Decorative Rocks & Crystals

Each specimen displays a rough, dark natural exterior matrix contrasting with the shimmering druzy crystal pockets inside, making them ideal for display, crystal collections, crafting, or educational study.

11 individual geode halves ranging in size from approximately 2.5 to 5 inches across

Natural dark matrix outer rinds with rugged, unpolished rocky surfaces
